hooks.command: for d in .. . "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; do if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -x "$d/.ai/bin/guard" ]; then d=$(cd "$d" && pwd) && exec "$d/.ai/bin/guard" "$d/.ai/guard.json"; fi; done; echo '{"decision":"deny","reason":"[dashcrew guard] .ai/bin/guard not found from the hooks folder; run dashcrew sync"}'
